name: State-Variable Telescoping Cost
description: The cost increment is rewritten using a telescoping sum (p1 + B_new - B_old) that is mathematically identical to the original increment (grid draw + p2). This completely removes the constant p2 addition from the surface text, forcing the model to algebraically deduce that the total cost simplifies to sum(p1) + B_final, and further deduce that minimizing B_final is equivalent to minimizing the flow-shop makespan.
